postings.title: Ground Operations and Mission Management
Junior Internal Auditor
Mission Planning System Engineer
postings.description:
Job Description:

Closer to Space, closer to the Future: join Telespazio – Leonardo Space Division!

Leonardo is a leading global industrial group in Aerospace, Defence and Security, delivering advance multi-domain technologies across Helicopters, Aircraft, Aerostructures, Electronics, Cybersecurity, and Space. As part of the Leonardo Space Division, Telespazio a joint venture between Leonardo (67%) and Thales (33%), is a global reference in the field of satellite solutions and services. With a workforce of over 3.500 professionals across its offices in Europe and around the world, Telespazio operates an international network of Space Centres and Teleports, offering cutting-edge solutions in Geoinformation Services, Satellite Systems and Operations, and Satellite Communications.

Join us as we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible in Space.

For our headquarters in Rome, we are looking for a Mission Planning System Engineer with 5–7 years of experience in the design and development of Mission Planning Systems for satellite Ground Segments.

The role focuses on the design and coordination of Mission Planning solutions for different satellite missions, including Earth Observation and Optical Communication, ensuring the generation of Mission Plans and compliance with key Power, Thermal, Guidance, Platform and Payload constraints. The candidate will work in a multidisciplinary team and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders, contributing to projects managed according to Agile/SCRUM methodologies.

Activities/Responsibilities:

- Analysing the mission requirements and mission constraints to determine the satellite models to be adopted
- To design, coordinate the development of software solutions for Mission planning system also in big constellation scenarios
- To analyse and integrate external satellite models (e.g. external guidance libraries) into the Mission Planning system
- To contribute to the technical project documentation (such as Requirements Documents, Operations Concept Document, Operations Engineering Plan, User and Administration Manual, Test Procedures, etc.)
- To assist in project reviews if/when required

Competencies:

- Master’s Degree in Aerospace, Automation or Information Engineering with competences in Flight Dynamics
- Proven Experience in Mission Planning system design and implementation
- Software Design Principles
- Experience in Microservices applications design
- Knowledge of Programming Languages: Java, Python
- Knowledge of security coding standards (OWASP, CWE/SANS)
- Knowledge of Container Orchestration frameworks (Kubernetes, OpenShift, etc)
- High-level written and verbal English communication skills
- Experience with the AI agent development ecosystem (e.g., LangChain, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI) and ability to integrate generative components within microservices architectures, handling aspects such as guardrails, output validation, and error management in asynchronous workflows

Further Skills:

- Knowledge about configuration management domain (GIT, GITLAB, etc)
- Knowledge of software security mechanisms (encryption, signature)
- Experience in Multiple technology stacks application development

What We Offer:

- Our applicable collective labor agreement is the CCNL for the Private Metalworking Industry and Plant Installation Sector
- Working arrangement: Hybrid
- Employment category: Employee
- Contract type: Permanent-term
- 13th-month salary payment
- Performance bonus linked to Business results
- Welfare vouchers worth €250 per year.
- Meal vouchers worth €9, usable at the company cafeteria or for external expenses
- Continuous learning and development opportunities to enhance both technical expertise and interpersonal skills

The Company reserves the right to assess the job grade and compensation package based on objective criteria identified during the recruitment process and in line with the seniority level of the selected candidate and the position itself, in compliance with the principles of fairness, transparency and equal opportunities established by applicable legislation.

How Does the Recruitment Process Work?

Following the collection of applications, we review and identify the candidates whose profiles best match the required qualifications and skills. Selected candidates will participate in an initial interview with the Human Resources team, focused on getting to know the candidate, as well as assessing motivation and personal competencies. This is followed by a more in-depth technical interview conducted together with the relevant Business team. At the end of the selection process, candidates receive feedback regardless of the outcome, whether positive or negative. For more information, please visit the following link: Join a Global Company

Why Telespazio: At Telespazio, the well-being, safety and development of our people are at the heart of our corporate culture. We actively foster an inclusive, diverse and stimulating work environment, promoting the principles of equity and the value of diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

4–7 anni di esperienza professionale, con esperienza significativa in ruoli di Project Management.

Esperienza nella gestione del cliente e nel coordinamento di team cross-funzionali.

Solida conoscenza delle metodologie di Project Management.

Capacità di pianificazione, monitoraggio e controllo.

Capacità di gestione di rischi, criticità e priorità concorrenti.

Capacità di interfacciarsi con clienti e stakeholder di livello senior.

Conoscenza della lingua inglese, livello B2

Qualifiche

Laurea preferibilmente in discipline ingegneristiche, scientifiche, economiche o gestionali.

Costituisce titolo preferenziale il possesso di certificazioni di Project Management, quali PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 o equivalenti.

Esperienza in contesti tecnologici complessi.

Conoscenza di strumenti di pianificazione e controllo quali MS Project, SAP o equivalenti.

Esperienza nella gestione di clienti istituzionali, grandi aziende o organizzazioni internazionali.

Esperienza nei settori Space, Earth Observation, Aerospace, Defence, ICT o servizi tecnologici B2B/B2G.

postings.title: Telespazio - Fullstack Software Engineer
postings.description:
Job Description:

Closer to Space, closer to the Future: join Telespazio – Leonardo Space Division!

Leonardo is a leading global industrial group in Aerospace, Defence and Security, delivering advance multi-domain technologies across Helicopters, Aircraft, Aerostructures, Electronics, Cybersecurity, and Space. As part of the Leonardo Space Division, Telespazio a joint venture between Leonardo (67%) and Thales (33%), is a global reference in the field of satellite solutions and services. With a workforce of over 3.500 professionals across its offices in Europe and around the world, Telespazio operates an international network of Space Centres and Teleports, offering cutting-edge solutions in Geoinformation Services, Satellite Systems and Operations, and Satellite Communications.

Join us as we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible in Space.

For our headquarters in Rome, we are looking for a Full-stack Software Engineer with 5–7 years of hands-on experience in designing, developing and testing software solutions for Ground Segment systems. The role involves the design and development of cloud-native applications, including multi-device and multi-platform front-end solutions using Angular, as well as enterprise back-end applications based on microservices architectures. The candidate will work in a multidisciplinary team and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders, contributing to projects managed according to Agile/SCRUM methodologies.

Activities/Responsibilities:

- Design, develop and unit test software solutions and end-to-end applications using modern technologies in public and hybrid cloud environments
- Design and implement automated DevSecOps pipelines to support continuous integration, delivery and deployment
- Contribute to the preparation and maintenance of technical project documentation, including Requirements Documents, Operations Concept Documents, Operations Engineering Plans, User Manuals and Administration Manuals
- Support project reviews and technical meetings when required

Competencies:

- Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Information Engineering, or a related field

- Define the operations organisation: roles, responsibilities, and operational interfaces

- Assess industrial deliverables against operational requirements: review of contractor documentation, RID generation and disposition, and technical support to ESA-led milestone reviews

- Plan and support operational validation campaigns

Job Description:

Closer to Space, closer to the Future: join Telespazio – Leonardo Space Division!

Leonardo is a leading global industrial group in Aerospace, Defence and Security, delivering advance multi-domain technologies across Helicopters, Aircraft, Aerostructures, Electronics, Cybersecurity, and Space. As part of the Leonardo Space Division, Telespazio a joint venture between Leonardo (67%) and Thales (33%), is a global reference in the field of satellite solutions and services. With a workforce of over 3.500 professionals across its offices in Europe and around the world, Telespazio operates an international network of Space Centres and Teleports, offering cutting-edge solutions in Geoinformation Services, Satellite Systems and Operations, and Satellite Communications.

Join us as we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible in Space.

Inside the Ground Segment and Systems Engineering Area in Rome, we are looking for a Verification and Validation Test Engineer to be assigned to the System Deployment and Qualification Unit.

He/She is responsible for the definition and execution of tests campaign as part of the Integration, Verification and Validation activities for Satellite Systems Ground Segments (G/S). He/She shall work in an integrated IVV team for the preparation and execution of the test campaigns of complex systems.

Activities/Responsibilities:

- Contribute to scheduling, preparation and execution of the IVV campaigns
- Requirements verification test method definition (DVCMs)
- Test Scenarios definition
- IVV Plans and procedures preparation
- Participate in the execution of test procedures using the approved IVV plans and in agreement with the test campaigns, including contribution to Test Readiness Reviews (TRRs) and Test Review Board meetings (TRBs)
- Prepare test execution and reports
- Investigation and analysis of anomalies
- Participate to formal reviews and key points
- Support the Technical Manager in the IVV duties

Qualifications / Experience:

- Master's Degree or equivalent from an institution of higher education in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science or related fields
- At least 3 years of experience

Essential Skills:

- Proven experience in Integration, Verification & Validation (IVV) activities, including identification of necessary test data and tools, software testing, software debugging
- Strong proficiency with Windows and Linux operating systems.
- Knowledge of Virtual Environments (VMWare, esxi, vsphere, openstack, KVM)
- Knowledge of containers technology and related environments (e.g. Dockers, Kubernetes)
- Knowledge of shell scripting
- Good English knowledgee

Desirable Skills:

- Knowledge of space and ground system engineering processes, and system and software life-cycles and standards (e.g. ECSS)
- Knowledge of Agile/DevOps models and related testing approach (e.g. Jenkins)
- Knowledge of programming languages (Java, Python, Bash script, Javascript)
- Knowledge of Cloud-based infrastructure and applications, microservices architectures
- Knowledge of Networking, Network Protocols and related issues

Place of work: Rome, Availability to travel EU and extra-EU

What We Offer:

- Our applicable collective labor agreement is the CCNL for the Private Metalworking Industry and Plant Installation Sector.
